bingNews.injectedCss:
:is(.newsitem .title):where([data-readomi-layout-owner], [data-readomi-layout-owner] *):has(.read-frog-translated-content-wrapper) { max-height: none; -webkit-line-clamp: unset; }

injectedCss.add: :is(#hot .g_book > a > h3):where([data-readomi-layout-owner], [data-readomi-layout-owner] *):has(.read-frog-translated-content-wrapper) { overflow: visible; max-height: none; -webkit-line-clamp: unset; }

:is(#detail_chapter .box_content ul li):where([data-readomi-layout-owner], [data-readomi-layout-owner] *):has(.read-frog-translated-content-wrapper) { height: unset !important; overflow: visible !important; }
:is(.book_list ul li):where([data-readomi-layout-owner], [data-readomi-layout-owner] *):has(.read-frog-translated-content-wrapper) { height: unset !important; overflow: visible !important; }
